name: Havoc Warriors
background:
The Havoc Warriors are fanatical followers of the Havoc Gods, and their numbers consist of everything from skilled warriors adorned in heavy armour to berserkers with only their faith and fury to protect them, supported by hordes of mutants and daemons. 

Their strange and varied warbands strike fear into the hearts of their foes. Many different peoples have been driven to embrace the worship of Havoc, often seeking salvation from death, whether by enemies, disease, or any number of other causes. Scattered and driven into hiding after their Gods were sealed, the Havoc Warriors have returned in the wake of the Great Rift.
backgroundFull:
Human tribes were slow to settle the Northlands. Their numbers were always few, and they relied more on hunting than farming. Gradually, the Human Empire began to expand northward, even into the previously remote tribal lands. Some northern tribes were conquered, but many others joined willingly as allies, seeking to benefit from peace, trade, and infrastructure. 

The Northlands were seen as a frontier territory by the Human Empire. Some roads were built, and a few soldiers were sent north, but in the end, little changed for Northerners as the soldiers were too few to prevent raids from neighbours, and few traders bothered to come north along the roads. Instead, outcasts and criminals would often flee north in order to hide from the law, making the Northlands more dangerous than they had ever been. 

The arrival of the Havoc Gods in Tyria caused a great deal of instability, as many began to worship these new Gods. The Empire recalled many of their troops to defend their Capital and nearby regions, hoping to put down any rebellions there, abandoning the northern tribes, and leaving them to deal with the Daemons on their own. 

By the time that the Havoc Wars had begun in full, most of the northern tribes had either united under Havoc or were wiped out by those who did. Some just hoped to be spared, others sought revenge against the Empire and some hoped that Havoc might offer them better lives. The warriors of these tribes crushed the northern Dwarves before turning south. The followers of Havoc, or Havoc Warriors, drove deep into the Empire, pillaging as they went. 

When the Havoc Gods were sealed away, the Daemons and their mortal followers were soon routed, and the surviving Havoc Warriors fled north. Still weakened by war, the Empire and its allies were not able to fully reoccupy the Northlands. Instead, they built a series of forts along its border in order to defend their lands. Though scattered and weakened, the Havoc Warriors remained, fighting amongst themselves for what little food and wealth they could scavenge, as well as anyone foolish enough to venture into their land without military protection. 

The opening of the Great Rift was greeted with celebration in the Northlands as the Havoc Warriors regained their magic and their gods. Now, the tribes are looking south with new energy, plundering their weakened neighbours, and waiting for the chance to strike into the heart of Tyria once more. 

How will you bring glory to your god?

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

specialRules.name: Steadfast Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Steadfast. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Havocbound
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies for the first time each round, its weapons get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Shred when Shooting
specialRules.description: This model gets Shred when shooting.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Buff
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 friendly units within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Havocbound
specialRules.description: If this model has Havocbound, it always gets AP(+1) from Havocbound (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Versatile Expert
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) when attacking, or get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

specialRules.name: Heavy Impact
specialRules.description: Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1).

specialRules.name: Scourge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon counts as having dealt 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.

specialRules.name: Ranged Shrouding
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy, as long as this unit hasn't started an activation yet this round, attackers get -4"" range to a min. of 6" when shooting at it.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Versatile Defense Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Dangerous Terrain Debuff
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Piercing Warrior
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies for the first time each round, its weapons get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Piercing Warrior
specialRules.description: If this model has Piercing Warrior, it always gets AP(+1) from Piercing Warrior (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Impact
specialRules.description: When charging, before either unit attacks, roll X dice, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes 1 hit.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Versatile Defense
specialRules.description: As long as a unit where most models have this rule hasn't activated yet this round, pick one effect when it is attacked: the unit either gets +1 to Defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. Note that you may pick a different effect each time the unit is attacked.
